svg.title: tl-mltl evaluates a formula on a trace
svg.desc: A formula and a trace go into tl-mltl. evaluate_closed or evaluate_prefix returns a verdict, here true at time 0, and pending when the prefix does not decide it. analyze_horizon returns a lookahead of 2 and a buffer of 3 instants. map_to_c2po returns a manifest with the C2PO expression and SHA-256 digests of its input and output. C2PO and R2U2 run outside this crate, and compare_external classifies their verdict against the reference verdict, here 8 of 8 supported cases agree.

g.data-text: formula: n0 proposition 0; n1 proposition 1; n2 until [1,2] of n0, n1; mltl.online-prefix/v1
MappingManifest: C2PO s0 U[1,2] s1; SHA-256 digests
verdict: true at time 0; or pending
compare_external: value, time to agreement: 8 of 8 supported: then (call) (call relation)
evaluate_prefix: or evaluate_closed to verdict: true at time 0; or pending: then (call) (call relation)
formula: n0 proposition 0; n1 proposition 1; n2 until [1,2] of n0, n1; mltl.online-prefix/v1 to evaluate_prefix: or evaluate_closed: then (call) (call relation)
formula: n0 proposition 0; n1 proposition 1; n2 until [1,2] of n0, n1; mltl.online-prefix/v1 to analyze_horizon: checked sums: then (call) (call relation)
formula: n0 proposition 0; n1 proposition 1; n2 until [1,2] of n0, n1; mltl.online-prefix/v1 to map_to_c2po: online-prefix only: then (call) (call relation)
analyze_horizon: checked sums to HorizonReport: lookahead 2; buffer 3: then (call) (call relation)
MappingManifest: C2PO s0 U[1,2] s1; SHA-256 digests to R2U2 4.2: out of band: then (call) (call relation)
map_to_c2po: online-prefix only to MappingManifest: C2PO s0 U[1,2] s1; SHA-256 digests: then (call) (call relation)
R2U2 4.2: out of band to compare_external: value, time: then (call) (call relation)
trace: {} {0,1} {1} {1}; propositions per instant to evaluate_prefix: or evaluate_closed: trace (call) (call relation)
verdict: true at time 0; or pending to compare_external: value, time: verdict (call) (call relation)
